# Ferrant Oake

## Overview

The Company's factor at [[Tallow Quay]], and — he says — a Lamplighter before that.

## Background

Keeps the Company's older records himself rather than in the counting house, which is
either caution or theft depending on who is asked.

## The Warning (Session 3)

Told [[Petra Vance]] that the Silt Accord had been signed once before and had not held.
Would not say by whom, and would not repeat it in front of the others.

## Character Assessment

Precise, careful, and frightened of something he has not named.

## Connections

- [[The Ambergris Company]]
- [[Petra Vance]]
- [[The Silt Accord]]

## Seen Again (Session 4)

Not at the quay when the crew returned, and nobody would say where he had gone.

## Notes

His account of the first accord contradicts the Company's. One of them is lying and it
matters which.
